items.title: Student Intern
items.description: Rotated across 4 divisions: Corporate and Industrial Risks (CIR), Financial, SME and Affinity Risks (FSA), General Claims and Risk Management (GCRM), and Employee Benefit, gaining exposure to insurance products and broker operations.
achievements: Reviewed and prepared quotation, proposal, placing slip, confirmation slip, renewal notice, invoice, and policy documents, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of information.
Supported renewal and claims administration, including preparing renewal notices, registering claims, monitoring claim progress, and updating claim status through the internal system.

Coordinated with Marketing and internal teams to obtain required information and documentation, while analyzing group health insurance data for an insurance case study that achieved 82% test accuracy.
